messages:
Sam Green: Omega Health (CISO + infra) just pushed a milestone — they want p95 latency <= 250ms on a private deployment, streaming support, KMS + audit logs. Target delivery date they asked for is 2026-05-15. Lina flagged this as a contract milestone and asked if we can commit.
Lina (AE): Confirmed. Legal wants redline done by 2026-05-20. They're open to an uplift for SLA but need explicit rollback and fallback to hosted API. 
Priya Rao: We need to scope this carefully. Streaming + KMS + p95 250ms on private is nontrivial. Do we have their expected QPS and typical token lengths?
Jorge Alvarez: Asked them for numbers. They said peak ~600 concurrent sessions, avg ~40 tokens/response, bursts to 1200. If accurate, hitting p95=250ms likely requires dedicated pool + aggressive batching/quantization or reduced context windows.
Ethan Kim: Quick ops POV: extra ~4xA100-equivalent GPUs for the private cluster, plus KMS integration work and audit pipeline. Ops ETA ~3 weeks from spec sign-off for infra provisioning and baseline testing.
Sam Green: Proposal options so we can discuss tradeoffs:
```
A) Full scope by 2026-05-15: streaming + KMS + p95 250ms (requires expedited eng + infra budget, 4-week dedicated sprint)
B) Split delivery: KMS + audit + private control plane by 2026-05-15; streaming + perf tuning (p95) by 2026-06-15
C) Offer alternative SLA: p99 <= 300ms or p95 250ms for hosted + staged private pilot for p95 commitments
```
Priya Rao: I'm leaning to B. Gives legal & customer something tangible on the contractual date while buying eng time for performance work. We'll need clear acceptance criteria for each stage.
Lina (AE): Omega said staged rollout is acceptable if we include rollback and a fallback path to hosted Redwood API if private issues occur.
Jorge Alvarez: For plan B, rough engineering workstreams: 1) KMS integration (2w), 2) private control plane + RBAC (1w), 3) telemetry + audit logs (1w), 4) perf tuning + load tests for p95 (3w). Some of these can run in parallel if we prioritize.
Priya Rao: Product should produce an SOW today with explicit deliverables, acceptance tests, and success metrics (inc. p95 test harness, acceptance load profile). Sam — can you draft SOW + RACI?
Sam Green: I'll draft the SOW and a basic runbook by EOD and loop in legal + finance for uplift and budget. 
Ethan Kim: Ops can commit to a 2-week post-launch on-call window and an operational runbook. Need approval for infra spend and capacity reservation to meet p95 targets.
deploy-bot: milestone created: omega-health-stage-delivery (due 2026-05-15)
Lina (AE): Next step — quick sync Sam + Priya + Jorge 10:30 PT. I'll send a calendar invite. :calendar:
Sam Green: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
